2607.00828.title: Exploring the Semantic Gap in Agentic Data Systems: A Formative Study of Operationalization Failures in Analytical Workflows
2607.00828.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate queries, invoke tools, and construct analytical workflows. Although recent advances have substantially improved workflow generation and execution, the semantic information required to operationalize analytical concepts often lies beyond what is explicitly represented in database schemas and data values. We present a cross-domain formative study of operationalization failures in agent-generated analytical workflows. Across 236 analytical intents spanning finance, human resources, and public safety domains, we identify 153 recurring failures despite successful workflow generation and execution. Our analysis reveals five recurring classes of failures: comparative grounding, process reasoning, quantitative reasoning, role confusion, and policy grounding. These findings suggest a semantic gap between user-level analytical concepts and the information available to workflow-generation systems. More broadly, they raise questions about the admissibility of analytical operations and suggest that future agentic data systems may require richer semantic representations to bridge the gap between analytical intent and executable computation.
2607.00828.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地用於生成查詢、調用工具和構建分析工作流程。儘管最近的進展已大大改善了工作流程的生成和執行，但將分析概念實際運用所需的語義信息往往超出了數據庫架構和數據值中明確表示的內容。我們提出了一項跨領域的形成性研究，探討代理生成的分析工作流程中的操作化失敗。在涵蓋財務、人力資源和公共安全領域的236個分析意圖中，我們識別出153個重複出現的失敗，儘管工作流程的生成和執行成功。我們的分析揭示了五類重複出現的失敗：比較基礎、過程推理、定量推理、角色混淆和政策基礎。這些發現表明用戶級分析概念與工作流程生成系統可用信息之間存在語義差距。更廣泛地說，這些發現引發了有關分析操作可接受性的問題，並表明未來的代理數據系統可能需要更豐富的語義表示，以彌合分析意圖與可執行計算之間的差距。
2607.00828.author: Jalal Mahmud et.al.
